thread.title: Broadcom profit beats estimates on data centre strength

title: Broadcom profit beats estimates on data centre strength
text:
June 7, 2018 / 8:34 PM / Updated 10 minutes ago Broadcom profit beats estimates on data centre strength Reuters Staff 1 Min Read
(Reuters) - Broadcom Inc’s ( AVGO.O ) quarterly profit beat Wall Street estimates as demand for its networking chips and storage solutions from data centres offset weakness in its wireless business, which boasts of customers such as Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ). FILE PHOTO: A sign to the campus offices of chip maker Broadcom Ltd, who announced on Monday an unsolicited bid to buy peer Qualcomm Inc for $103 billion, is shown in Irvine, California, U.S., November 6, 2017. REUTERS/Mike Blake/File photo
The San Jose, California-based company also forecast current-quarter revenue of $5.05 billion, plus or minus $75 million, above analysts’ estimates of $5.06 billion.
The company’s net income attributable to common stock rose to $3.72 billion, or $8.33 per share, in the second quarter ended May 6, from $440 million, or $1.05 per share, a year earlier.
Net revenue jumped to $5.01 billion from $4.19 billion.
Excluding items, the company earned $4.88 per share.
Analysts on average had expected earnings of $4.76 per share on revenue of $5.00 billion, according to Thomson Reuters I/B/E/S. Reporting by Sonam Rai in Bengaluru; Editing by Maju Samuel
